messages.author: 645e2b041ea2a63e
messages.subject: blavaan 0.4-8
parts:
blavaan 0.4-8 is now on CRAN. It fixes a few bugs and updates how Stan model compilation is handled at installation. The plan is for this to be the final release of the 0.4 series, with the 0.5 series adding some multilevel functionality (initially, random intercepts for continuous observed variables).

Ed
